tagline: Sound engineer, trail runner, dumpling scholar.

chat.text: Hi! I'm here to help you meet people worth meeting. Who are you, and what does a good week look like?
I'm a sound engineer and a bit of a night-time wanderer. A perfect week is a trail run, a good jazz set, and dumplings with friends.
Love that. How do you typically spend your weekends?
I'm out on the Marin Headlands trails most Saturday mornings, then I'm hunting for the best dumplings in the city.
What's your food personality? What would you happily eat on repeat?
Soup dumplings are my love language. Also a hole-in-the-wall noodle guy. I'll cook for you if you let me.
What else fills your free time?
Live jazz, board games with my roommates, and long runs. I play upright bass, badly.
Tell me about work. Does it leave room for dating?
I freelance so my hours bend. I actually have time and energy for dating, which is rare.
Drinking: where do you land?
I'll have a whiskey or two when there's music, but never to excess.
Smoking or vaping, anything I should know, either way?
I still smoke a few cigarettes when I'm out with friends, mostly at shows. I'm trying to cut down but I'm not there yet.
Kids: where are you on that?
I could see kids in the future but I'm in no rush.
Any pets in your life?
No pets right now because my landlord is strict, but I'm a dog person all the way.
How big a role do religion or spirituality play, and what do you value most in people?
Religion isn't a big thing for me. Honesty, loyalty and showing up matter more.
Early bird or night owl?
I'm up early for runs, so I'm a morning person even after late shows. Weird combo, I know.
What kind of person are you hoping to meet?
I want someone adventurous and kind who is up for a spontaneous trail and a late dumpling dinner.
Anything that's a hard no for you?
Flakiness is my pet peeve. I'm pretty easy otherwise.
Final question: which times next week could work for a first date?
Sunday late morning, Monday evening and Wednesday evening all work for me.
Thanks, that's plenty to work with. I'll look for matches quietly and keep your private details private until you both opt in.
